news.title: Is Netflix Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
news.summary: Netflix (NFLX) keeps more of each sales dollar than almost every company in its peer group. Yet its stock is one of the cheapest in that group. Among five companies, Netflix ranks second on operating margin. It has the fourth-highest price to earnings ratio, which makes it the second cheapest. So is Netflix stock worth more than its competitors.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股票是否比其競爭對手更有價值？
news.summary_zh: Netflix (NFLX) 保留的每一美元銷售額比同業幾乎所有公司都多。然而其股票在該群組中卻是最便宜的之一。在五家公司中，Netflix 的營業利潤率排名第二。其市盈率排名第四高，使其成為第二便宜。那麼 Netflix 股票是否比競爭對手更有價值。

news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
news.summary: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.

news.title_zh: 若您今天在台積電投資 $1,000，到 2030 可能值多少
news.summary_zh: 全球最大晶片製造商正全力運轉晶圓廠，股價卻在一個月內大幅下滑。三大力量可能為耐心投資人帶來豐厚回報，但一項風險可能將一切歸零。

news.title: Novanta Shares Just Jumped And We’re Buying This Robotics Play
news.summary: Just as early investors targeted foundational chipmakers like Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM), Nvidia (NVDA), and Broadcom (AVGO) at the start of the AI computing wave, investors are currently examining diversified industrial and sensor plays such as Regal Rexnord (RRX), Timken (TKR), Allegro MicroSystems (ALGM), Ouster (OUST), and STMicroelectronics (STM). During a recent episode of The AI Investor Podcast, hosts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith took a closer look at Novanta, and shared why they are optimistic about the robotics manufacturer as an AI investment play to target in 2027.
news.title_zh: Novanta 股價飆漲，我們正買入這檔機器人概念股
news.summary_zh: 正如早期投資者在 AI 運算浪潮初期鎖定台積電 (TSM)、輝達 (NVDA) 和博通 (AVGO) 等晶片龍頭，投資人目前正審視 Regal Rexnord (RRX)、Timken (TKR)、Allegro MicroSystems (ALGM)、Ouster (OUST) 和意法半導體 (STM) 等多元化工業與感測器標的。在《The AI Investor Podcast》近期一集中，主持人 Eric Bleeker 和 Austin Smith 深入分析 Novanta，並分享為何看好這家機器人製造商作為 2027 的 AI 投資標的。

news.title: TSMC: What A Textbook Growth Stock Should Look Like
news.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor's over 70% pure-play foundry share underpins pricing power with 65% gross margins.
news.title_zh: TSMC：教科書級成長股的樣貌
news.summary_zh: 台積電超過 70% 的純晶圓代工市佔率支撐定價權，擁有 65% 毛利率。

news.title: SK hynix vs. TSMC: One Chipmaker's Revenue Is Exploding, but Is It the Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: The AI boom is generating record sales for two of the semiconductor industry's most important suppliers, but their quarterly revenue trends reveal how differently each company is capitalizing on the surge in demand.
news.title_zh: SK hynix 對決 TSMC：一家晶片廠營收暴增，但它是 2027 的更佳買點嗎？
news.summary_zh: AI 熱潮為半導體產業兩大關鍵供應商帶來創紀錄銷售，但其季度營收趨勢揭示各家獲利方式大不相同。

news.title: Alphabet Soars 6% as Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Reignites AI Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphabet stock rose 6% as Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia sparked a rally in AI stocks, led by names like Taiwan Semiconductor and CoreWeave. Alphabet held up in Friday’s sell-off, so it had less ground to win back.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 飆升 6%，隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 Nvidia 重燃 AI 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Alphabet 股價上漲 6%，隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 Nvidia 引發 AI 股票反彈，領漲者包括台積電和 CoreWeave。Alphabet 在週五的拋售中表現堅挺，因此需要收回的失地較少。

news.title: Nvidia vs. TSMC: With Jensen Huang Back, Which AI Stock Is the Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Following a turbulent stretch for semiconductor stocks, investors must decide whether Nvidia's exceptional profitability or TSMC's broader exposure to the AI industry offers the more compelling opportunity heading into 2027.
news.title_zh: Nvidia vs. TSMC：隨著黃仁勳回歸，哪檔 AI 股票是 2027 更好的買入選擇？
news.summary_zh: 經歷半導體股票的一段動盪期後，投資者必須決定 Nvidia 的卓越獲利能力或 TSMC 對 AI 產業更廣泛的曝光，哪一項在進入 2027 時提供更具吸引力的機會。

news.title: A $1.9 Billion Fund Is Betting Big on Taiwan Semiconductor
news.summary: Key TakeawaysFirst Long Island Investors, which manages $1. 86 billion, raised its Taiwan Semiconductor stake 67% last quarter, making it the fund’s third-largest holding, and opened a new position in Lumentum.
news.title_zh: 一家 $1.9 Billion 基金重押台積電
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要First Long Island Investors 管理 $1。86 billion，上季增持台積電股份 67%，使其成為該基金第三大持股，並新增 Lumentum 部位。

news.title: Stanley Druckenmiller, Leopold Aschenbrenner and 25 Other Big Funds Sold Taiwan Semiconductor Last Quarter, While 38 Bought. Who’s Right?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOf 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 38 bought Taiwan Semiconductor and 27 sold, with Stanley Druckenmiller’s and Leopold Aschenbrenner’s funds among the sellers.
news.title_zh: Stanley Druckenmiller、Leopold Aschenbrenner 和 25 家其他大型基金上季出售台積電，而 38 則買入。誰是對的？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：在已為截至 Sept. 30 季度提交 13F 文件的 460 家大型基金中，38 家買入台積電，27 家賣出，Stanley Druckenmiller 和 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下基金位於賣方之列。

news.title: A $164 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks Last Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysA fund that manages $164 billion added heavily to Nvidia, Taiwan Semiconductor and Microsoft in the third quarter, per its latest 13F. All three stocks have fallen since Sept.
news.title_zh: 一家 $164 Billion 基金上季買入這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要一家管理 $164 billion 的基金第三季大幅加碼輝達、台積電和微軟，據其最新 13F 申報。這三檔股票自九月以來皆下跌。

news.title: A $9.7 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks Last Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysA $9. 7 billion fund, Hyperion Asset Management, added to its stakes in SpaceX, Arm Holdings and Taiwan Semiconductor in the third quarter.
news.title_zh: 一家 $9.7 Billion 基金上季買入了這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要一家 $9。7 billion 基金 Hyperion Asset Management 在第三季增加了對 SpaceX、Arm Holdings 和台積電的持股。

news.title: Following Jensen Huang Exit, Investors Fear Nvidia’s AI Lead Will Collapse
news.summary: Even though Nvidia remains a massive holding and is forecasting up to 70% growth in its next fiscal year, the stock has been trading at a steep discount around 12 to 13 times forward earnings amid major leadership and competitive shifts. Following Jensen Huang’s departure, investors are wrestling with how deeply Nvidia's advantage was tied to his hands-on leadership, annual product cadence and supply chain relationships like its handshake deals with Taiwan Semiconductor. 24/7 Wall St. Analysts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith examine what Nvidia might look like with Jensen Huang gone and why fears of a collapse are valid.
news.title_zh: 隨著黃仁勳離職，投資者擔心 Nvidia 的 AI 領先地位將崩塌
news.summary_zh: 儘管 Nvidia 仍是巨大持倉，並預測下一財年增長高達 70%，但該股票在重大領導層和競爭格局變化中，以約 12 to 13 times 遠期盈利的陡峭折價交易。隨著黃仁勳離職，投資者正在權衡 Nvidia 的優勢究竟有多深地依賴其親力親為的領導風格、年度產品節奏，以及像與台積電的握手協議等供應鏈關係。24/7 華爾街分析師 Eric Bleeker 和 Austin Smith 分析了沒有黃仁勳的 Nvidia 可能樣貌，以及崩塌恐懼為何合理。

news.title: AMD Stock Drops Another 7% Before the Bell and Taiwan Semiconductor Slides 4.2% as Nasdaq Futures Fall 1.6% After Asia’s Chip Selloff
news.summary: AMD was down another 7% before Friday's opening bell and Taiwan Semiconductor 4.2% after Taiwan's worst week since 1991. Nasdaq 100 futures were down 1.6% while Dow futures were flat. Here is what Asia's selloff means for the U.S. open.
news.title_zh: AMD 股票開盤前再跌 7%，台積電下滑 4.2%，納斯達克期貨跌 1.6%，亞洲晶片拋售後
news.summary_zh: AMD 在週五開盤鐘響前再跌 7%，台積電 4.2%，此前台灣經歷自 1991 以來最糟一週。納斯達克 100 期貨下跌 1.6%，道瓊期貨持平。這裡說明亞洲拋售對美股開盤的意義。

news.title: Is The Client Unit Still Carrying AMD Stock?

news.title: AMD Stock Would Need to Rise About 57% to Get Back to Its Record. History Says How Long Past Comebacks Took.
news.summary: The chipmaker has come back from drops this big six times -- at very different paces.

news.summary_zh: 這家晶片製造商已經從這麼大的跌幅中反彈了六次——速度各不相同。

news.title: Nvidia Author Stephen Witt Says Huang’s Return Is “Not Great for AMD.” Here’s What AMD Loses
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares fell 10% on Tuesday after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, 12 days after he resigned. Author Stephen Witt says Huang’s return is “not great for AMD,” since rivals had hoped to hire away Nvidia’s engineers.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 作者 Stephen Witt 說黃仁勳回歸「對 AMD 不利」。這是 AMD 失去的東西
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 AMD 股價在週二下跌 10%，此前 Nvidia 重新任命黃仁勳為 CEO，距離他辭職 12 天。作者 Stephen Witt 說黃仁勳的回歸「對 AMD 不利」，因為競爭對手原本希望挖角 Nvidia 的工程師。

news.title_zh: 若您今天在 Apple 投資 $1,000，到 2029 可能值多少
news.summary_zh: Apple 剛公布有史以來最佳財年，但華爾街共識目標價卻低於當前股價。五年模型為您的資金描繪三條截然不同的路徑，其中一條幾乎不會讓指標移動。

news.title_zh: 是什麼導致了美國的技術故障？

news.title: Has Buying Apple At A High Paid Off?
news.summary: "Buy low, never at the top" is one of the oldest rules in investing. Apple closed at a 52-week high of $356.27 on Friday, November 13. It closed just below that, at $355.58, on Wednesday. By the old rule, this is the wrong time to buy. Does the rule hold for this stock.

news.title: Here’s Why $35 Is The Price to Buy Intel, and No Higher
news.summary: Intel's data center business is booming, Nvidia is buying in, and analysts see big upside. Yet the stock has plunged in a month, and its foundry still has to prove itself. What would make the entry point finally worth the risk?

Intel sold 14% fewer PC chips last quarter, and its CFO expects the PC slowdown to last at least through the first half of 2027.

news.title: SK Hynix Just Revealed the Next Generation of DRAM. Can It Beat Micron in the Next Memory Supercycle?
news.summary: SK hynix is racing toward 100-layer 3D DRAM while both stocks trade at the same bargain multiple. Income, growth, and risk each pull in a different direction, and one overlooked weakness could decide who survives the next downturn.
news.title_zh: SK Hynix 剛發布新一代 DRAM。能否在下一輪記憶體超級週期中擊敗 Micron？
news.summary_zh: SK hynix 正全力衝刺 100 層 3D DRAM，而兩檔股票目前交易於相同的低估值倍數。獲利、成長與風險各自拉扯不同方向，一個被忽視的弱點可能決定誰能在下一次下行週期中倖存。

news.title: Jim Cramer Says Micron Stock Is “Comically Cheap” at About 3 Times Earnings
news.summary: Micron just posted the most profitable year in its history, yet the stock has shed a third of its value in a month. Memory's long record of boom and bust may explain why investors refuse to pay up.
news.title_zh: Jim Cramer 說 Micron 股票在約 3 Times 盈利下「便宜得可笑」
news.summary_zh: Micron 剛公布史上最獲利的一年，股價卻在一個月內蒸發三分之一。記憶體產業長期的榮枯週期或許能解釋為何投資人拒絕買單。

news.title: Is Micron Stock a Buy After HPE Said Memory Will Stay Scarce Into 2028?
news.summary: A big memory buyer and a bearish bank are now at least a year apart on when the shortage ends.
news.title_zh: HPE 表示記憶體短缺將持續至 2028，Micron 股票現在值得買進嗎？
news.summary_zh: 一大記憶體買家與一家看空銀行，對短缺何時結束的看法目前至少相差一年。

news.title: Micron Can’t Stop Sliding. UBS Cut Its Target, but Still Sees 83% Upside
news.summary: Key TakeawaysUBS cut its Micron price target to $1,100 from $1,625 on Nov. 25 but kept its Buy rating, with the stock down 50% from its June record close.
news.title_zh: Micron 無法止跌。UBS 下調目標價，但仍看好 83% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要UBS 將 Micron 目標價從 $1,625 下調至 $1,100，於 Nov. 25 維持買入評級，股價較六月歷史收盤高點下跌 50%。

news.title: Tepper Trims Alphabet by ~46% and Dumps Broadcom & AMD While Backing Micron and Oracle
news.summary: David Tepper sold off three AI winners that were still growing fast and bought two others instead. One of them pays its own way, while the other leans heavily on borrowed money and customer prepayments.
news.title_zh: Tepper 削減 Alphabet 持股約 ~46% 並拋售 Broadcom 與 AMD，同時看好 Micron 和 Oracle
news.summary_zh: David Tepper 拋售了三檔仍在快速成長的 AI 獲利股，並改為買入另外兩檔。其中一檔能自我造血，而另一檔則高度依賴借款和客戶預付款。

news.title: Micron Stock Has Lost Half Its Value Since June
news.summary: Micron Technology stock closed at $601.25 on Wednesday, Nov 25. It fell 4.5% that day. The stock now sits 50.5% below its record close of $1,213.56 on June 25. A reader of our piece on Micron at under ten times earnings asked for more. Since that request on Nov 19, the stock has dropped another 12.9.
news.title_zh: Micron 股價自六月以來腰斬
news.summary_zh: Micron Technology 股價於週三收於 $601.25，Nov 25。當日下跌 4.5%。股價目前較 June 25 歷史收盤高點 $1,213.56 低 50.5%。我們關於 Micron 低於十倍本益比的文章有讀者詢問更多細節。自該請求於 Nov 19 以來，股價又再下跌 12.9。

news.title: Micron's Margins Peaked Before. How Far Did MU Fall?
news.summary: Micron Technology kept 86.8% of its sales as gross profit in the three months to Sep 3, 2026. That share is called gross margin. It is what Micron keeps from its sales after paying to make its chips. It is the highest of the 115 quarters in our data, back to February 1998.
news.title_zh: Micron 利潤率曾見頂。MU 跌多深？
news.summary_zh: Micron Technology 在截至 Sep 3, 2026 的三個月內，將 86.8% 的營收保留為毛利。這個比例稱為毛利率。這是我們數據中 115 季以來最高的，回溯至 February 1998。

news.title: Micron’s Taiwan Expansion Plans Face Uncertainty Amid Ongoing Labour Dispute
news.summary: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) could reconsider its planned investments in Taiwan as an unresolved labour dispute raises concerns over the US memory chipmaker’s future manufacturing expansion, according to a report published by Taiwan’s Commercial Times on Thursday. The report cited Wealth Magazine chairman Hsieh Chin-ho, who warned that deteriorating labour relations could prompt Micron’s board to reassess planned investments totalling NT$1.
news.title_zh: 美光台灣擴廠計畫因勞資糾紛持續而面臨不確定性
news.summary_zh: 據《工商時報》週四發布的報導，美光科技 (NASDAQ:MU) 可能重新考慮其在台灣的計畫投資，因為未解決的勞資糾紛引發了對這家美國記憶體晶片製造商未來製造擴張的擔憂。報導引述《財訊》雜誌董事長謝金河警告，惡化的勞資關係可能促使美光董事會重新評估總額達 NT$1 的計畫投資。

news.title: Arm Drops 20% in a Week as AI Chips Slide. CEO Rene Haas Has “Never Been More Confident”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysArm fell 20% in a week as AI chips sold off, AMD and Micron with them. Only news was good: CEO Rene Haas signed on through 2033, ending the Nvidia talk.
news.title_zh: Arm 一週下跌 20% 隨著 AI 晶片下滑。CEO Rene Haas 表示「從未如此有信心」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Arm 一週下跌 20% 隨著 AI 晶片拋售，AMD 和 Micron 也跟著下跌。唯一的好消息是：CEO Rene Haas 簽約任職至 2033，結束了關於 Nvidia 的傳聞。

news.title: SK hynix Just Hit a New 52-Week Low After Sinking 9% in a Week. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix fell 9% in a week to a new 52-week low as AI chip stocks whipsawed around Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia’s CEO. The deeper worry is a memory downturn in 2028: Goldman Sachs cut its target on lower 2028 prices, and Micron and Sandisk fell even harder.
news.title_zh: SK海力士剛觸及新 52 週低點，單週下跌 9%。賣壓是否過度？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要SK海力士單週下跌 9%，觸及新 52 週低點，AI晶片股在輝達CEO黃仁勳回歸的消息下劇烈震盪。更深層的擔憂是 2028 的記憶體下行週期：高盛因較低的 2028 價格下調目標價，美光和Sandisk跌幅更大。

news.title: MU, SNDK, SKHY Jump As Nvidia Tests Kioxia Memory Fix — Analyst Presses Memory Giants For ‘Massive’ Buybacks
news.summary: Nvidia and Kioxia tested 144 flash drives in one AI rack. Kioxia estimates the setup could support a database of up to 2 trillion vectors.
news.title_zh: MU、SNDK、SKHY 上漲，輝達測試Kioxia記憶體修正方案 — 分析師敦促記憶體大廠進行「大規模」回購
news.summary_zh: 輝達與Kioxia在一個AI機架中測試了 144 快閃記憶體硬碟。Kioxia估計該配置可支援高達 2 trillion 向量的資料庫。

news.title: SOXL Crashes 32% in Its Third-Worst Day Ever and Is Down 90% From Its June Record. The Chip Index It Tracks Is Down 43%
news.summary: SOXL fell 32% on Friday, its third-worst day since 2010, and is 90% below its June record. The chip index it tracks is down 43%. South Korean retail investors held about a third of the fund.

news.title: Nvidia Has Fallen 18% Since the Jensen Huang Scandal Broke and the Biggest Chip ETF Barely Moved. Here’s What Tonight’s Report Does to SMH, SOXX, SOXL and NVDL
news.summary: Nvidia reports tonight with Colette Kress on the call and Jensen Huang saying he would return if asked. Since the scandal broke, Nvidia fell 18% while SMH, SOXX and SOXL barely moved. Here is Nvidia's weight in each fund from its own holdings file, what a 10% move does to $100,000 in each, what the last eight report nights did, and why the leveraged pair reset daily.

news.summary_zh: 輝達今晚發布財報，Colette Kress 參與電話會議，Jensen Huang 表示若被要求會回歸。醜聞爆發以來，輝達下跌 18%，而 SMH、SOXX 和 SOXL 幾乎未動。以下是輝達在各基金中的權重（來自其持倉檔案）、10% 變動對各基金 $100,000 的影響、過去八次財報夜的表現，以及槓桿配對為何每日重置。

news.title: SK hynix Just Hit a New 52-Week Low After Sinking 9% in a Week. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix fell 9% in a week to a new 52-week low as AI chip stocks whipsawed around Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia’s CEO. The deeper worry is a memory downturn in 2028: Goldman Sachs cut its target on lower 2028 prices, and Micron and Sandisk fell even harder.
news.title_zh: SK海力士剛觸及新 52 週低點，單週下跌 9%。賣壓是否過度？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要SK海力士單週下跌 9%，觸及新 52 週低點，AI晶片股在輝達CEO黃仁勳回歸的消息下劇烈震盪。更深層的擔憂是 2028 的記憶體下行週期：高盛因較低的 2028 價格下調目標價，美光和Sandisk跌幅更大。

news.title: MU, SNDK, SKHY Jump As Nvidia Tests Kioxia Memory Fix — Analyst Presses Memory Giants For ‘Massive’ Buybacks
news.summary: Nvidia and Kioxia tested 144 flash drives in one AI rack. Kioxia estimates the setup could support a database of up to 2 trillion vectors.

news.summary_zh: 輝達與Kioxia在一個AI機架中測試了 144 快閃記憶體硬碟。Kioxia估計該配置可支援高達 2 trillion 向量的資料庫。

news.title: Qualcomm vs. Sandisk: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Sandisk's revenue surged over 270%, driven by demand for cloud memory, while Qualcomm is branching into automotive and satellite connectivity. Which chip stock holds up better?

news.summary_zh: Sandisk 營收激增超過 270%，受惠於雲端記憶體需求，而高通正拓展汽車和衛星連接領域。哪檔晶片股表現較佳？

news.title: SK hynix Falls 5%, Sandisk Down 10% as Asian Chip Stocks Give Back the Huang Rally
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix fell 5% today as Asian chip stocks gave back most of their rally on Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia. TrendForce lowered its 2027 memory forecasts after Chinese cloud providers cut orders.
news.title_zh: SK 海力士下跌 5%，Sandisk 下跌 10%，亞洲晶片股吐回黃仁勳漲勢
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要SK 海力士今日下跌 5%，亞洲晶片股因黃仁勳重返輝達而吐回大部分漲幅。TrendForce 在中國雲端供應商削減訂單後，下調其 2027 記憶體預測。

news.title: Sandisk vs. Western Digital: Which Computer Drive Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Sandisk's revenue nearly tripled in FY 2026 while Western Digital leans heavily on cloud customers, but only one of these stocks trades at a lower forward multiple.
news.title_zh: Sandisk 對決 Western Digital：哪檔電腦硬碟股票在 2027 年更值得買入？
news.summary_zh: Sandisk 在 FY 2026 年營收近乎翻三倍，而 Western Digital 嚴重依賴雲端客戶，但這兩檔股票只有一檔以較低的遠期倍數交易。

news.title: Tesla Sinks 5%, Sandisk Down 13% as AI Selloff Deepens and EU Stalls FSD Approval
news.summary: Key TakeawaysTesla fell 5% today as the AI selloff deepened and the EU delayed a vote on Full Self-Driving to Dec. 15.
news.title_zh: Tesla 下跌 5%，Sandisk 下跌 13%，隨著 AI 拋售加深且 EU 暫緩 FSD 核准
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Tesla 今日下跌 5%，隨著 AI 拋售加深且 EU 將全自動駕駛投票推遲至 Dec. 15。

news.title: Cantor’s CJ Muse Sees Sandisk Buying Back “60% of the Outstanding Shares” Over Six Quarters
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCantor Fitzgerald’s CJ Muse says Sandisk could buy back 60% of its outstanding shares over the next six quarters at today’s valuation. Analysts expect about $52 billion of free cash flow over those six quarters, close to 60% of Sandisk’s roughly $89 billion market value.
news.title_zh: Cantor 的 CJ Muse 看好 Sandisk 在六個季度內回購「60% 的流通股」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Cantor Fitzgerald 的 CJ Muse 指出，按當前估值，Sandisk 未來六個季度可回購 60% 的流通股。分析師預期這六個季度的自由現金流約為 $52 billion，接近 Sandisk 約 $89 billion 市值的 60%。

news.title: Alphabet Falls 4% on AI Credit Fears as Strategist Warns Capex Is “As Good as It Gets”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphabet stock fell 4% today as the cost of insuring its debt hit a record, and Sandisk and Seagate fell with it. Alphabet burned $9.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 下跌 4% 因 AI 信貸擔憂，策略師警告資本支出「已達頂峰」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet 股價今日下跌 4%，因其債務保險成本創新高，Sandisk 和 Seagate 也隨之下跌。Alphabet 燒掉了 $9。

news.summary: Sandisk dropped again. And it's TrendForce's fault.

news.summary_zh: Sandisk 再度下跌。這是 TrendForce 的錯。

news.title: Amazon Sinks 6%, Sandisk Down 12% as AI Selloff Deepens: Bear Calls AI “Greatest Misallocation of Capital”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAmazon fell 6% today in an AI selloff that also hit Sandisk and Seagate. Anthropic, a big Amazon holding, fell below its $83 IPO price, a week after Oppenheimer raised its Amazon target on that stake.
news.title_zh: 亞馬遜下跌 6%，Sandisk下跌 12%，AI拋售加劇：空頭稱AI為「資本配置最大錯誤」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要亞馬遜今日在AI拋售中下跌 6%，Sandisk和Seagate也受衝擊。作為亞馬遜主要持股的Anthropic，跌破其 $83 IPO價格，這距離Oppenheimer因該持股上調亞馬遜目標價僅過一週。

news.title: Micron Falls 7% as a Weaker DRAM Outlook and New Tariffs Hit Memory Stocks; SanDisk Drops 7%: Are Micron and Memory Stocks Now a Value Play?
news.summary: Micron posted record AI-fueled results, yet its stock has shed a third of its value in a month as a cooler pricing forecast and a tariff threat collide. Does a single-digit P/E signal opportunity, or a classic cyclical trap?
news.title_zh: Micron 下跌 7%，因疲軟 DRAM 展望與新關稅打擊記憶體股票；SanDisk 下跌 7%：Micron 和記憶體股票現在是價值投資機會嗎？
news.summary_zh: Micron 發布由 AI 驅動的創紀錄業績，但其股價在一個月內蒸發三分之一價值，因降溫定價預測與關稅威脅同時發生。個位數市盈率預示機會，還是經典的週期性陷阱？

news.title: Global Stocks Climb as AI Trade Rebounds
news.summary: Stocks rose as investors in Europe and Asia tracked a comeback in technology shares on Wall Street, with days of sharp swings likely to give way to thin holiday trading. Europe’s Stoxx 600 jumped as much as 1.7%, with gains following late-session dip buying in the US that pulled the Nasdaq 100 back from the brink of a bear market ahead of Thanksgiving. The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: ADMA Biologics (NASDAQ:ADMA) COO Sells 30,000 Shares of Company Stock
news.summary: ADMA Biologics Inc (NASDAQ:ADMA - Get Free Report) COO Kaitlin Kestenberg-Messina sold 30,000 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, November 25th. news.title: Palantir Rips 10% to Lead Software Stocks. Cloudflare and ServiceNow Also Join ‘Jensen Rally’
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA is lifting technology stocks on Monday. The NASDAQ was up more than 7% as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern, after opening with a 3% pre-market gain following Friday's sell-off. Chip stocks as a group rose more than 13%. Software is also higher, but the gains are uneven. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) are each up about 3%, while the IGV software ETF is up 4%. The biggest winners are companies that benefit from sovereign AI and a strong open-weight ecosystem. Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) leads at 10%, and Palantir has been one of the loudest backers of sovereign AI. Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) is up roughly 7%, and ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is up 5%, helped by its control tower software that guides customers between models and agentic workloads. Anthropic is lagging, since Huang has pushed open-weight models that pressure leading labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. Bleeker's takeaway: if Huang keeps backing open weight model makers, Palantir, Cloudflare and ServiceNow, up 5% to 10%, should keep outperforming the 2% to 3% gains in the rest of software.
news.title_zh: Palantir 飆升 10% 領漲軟體股。Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 也加入「Jensen Rally」
news.summary_zh: 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 在 24/7 華爾街表示，黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA 於週一帶動科技股上漲。納斯達克指數截至 1:30 下午 (東部時間) 上漲逾 7%，此前受週五拋售潮影響，盤前漲幅達 3%。晶片股群體上漲逾 13%。軟體股也上漲，但漲幅不均。微軟 (NASDAQ: MSFT) 和 Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) 各上漲約 3%，而 IGV 軟體 ETF 上漲 4%。最大贏家是受惠於主權 AI 和強大開放權重生態系的公司。Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) 領漲 10%，且 Palantir 一直是主權 AI 最響亮的支持者之一。Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) 上漲約 7%，ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) 上漲 5%，得益於其控制塔軟體引導客戶在模型和代理式工作負載之間切換。Anthropic 表現落後，因黃仁勳推動開放權重模型，對 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等領先實驗室構成壓力。Bleeker 的結論：若黃仁勳持續支持開放權重模型製造商，Palantir、Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 上漲 5% to 10%，應會持續優於軟體其餘部分 2% to 3% 的漲幅。

news.title: Nebius & CoreWeave Jump 21% While Oracle Sees 12% Gains on Monday Following Jensen’s Return
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says neocloud stocks rallied Monday on the return of Jensen Huang to NVIDIA. At 1:30 p.m. Eastern, Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) and CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) were each up 21%, IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) was up 25%, TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) was up 13% and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was up 12%. Leading ETFs showed software up closer to 4% and semiconductors up 13%. Bleeker also pointed to two company-specific items. The New York Times reported that Anthropic's demand is so large that SpaceX needs new data centers by October to fill its orders. On Friday, Oracle said it has secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract. Bleeker notes Nvidia helped build neoclouds with funding, technical expertise and chips. He calls it a one-day win. Nebius is down 38% over the past month, CoreWeave 12% and Oracle 10%. Over six months Nebius is down more than 50%, Oracle 40% and CoreWeave 55%. Bleeker names three drivers of the selloff: higher rates and wider credit default swaps, political worries after the midterms, and Huang's removal. Only the last has reversed. Going forward, watch the Fed's rate path and how politics affects project locations such as Texas.
